about: Brock is a township in Durham Region, Ontario, covering Beaverton, Cannington, and Sunderland on the east and south shores of Lake Simcoe—not a city. Small-town Main Streets, farm country, and lake access share the landscape north of Uxbridge toward Orillia. About 13,000 people live in Brock Township.
